name: woori-answer-key
description: 우리WON뱅킹 클론 답지 — 루트 스크립트. 루트 의존성은 비교 하네스(tools/shot.cjs)용 playwright 하나뿐, 앱 패키지는 frontend/, backend/

scripts.setup: npm install && node tools/dev-woori.cjs --install && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && node tools/check-dist.cjs
scripts.check: node tools/spec-to-dp.cjs --check && node tools/gen-from-spec.cjs --check && node tools/check-dist.cjs --selftest
